results.name: Crane view links follow the split: Maintenance "Open in Jobs" opens Daily work (CMMS) for the equipment and today; Projects/Special opens Special/Projects with the scope; the legacy /eq/jobs route still lands on Special/Projects

Writers see "Add special job" in Special/Projects and in the crane view (whole equipment and any selection), pre-filled with the equipment and the selected mechanism/part; the job is created and appears as open; Management and FAC Team see no add action

Add spare part (simulated server): EQ Team and Admin add a non-designated active position with type, condition, date, brand and expected life; the entry starts its history (source registerAdd); Management and FAC Team are refused (403); duplicates, inactive positions, future dates, invalid life, unknown type and Original over recorded history are refused and save nothing; Admin-only designation settings stay Admin-only

Spare parts condition tab: "Add spare part" for EQ Team and Admin opens a form (equipment, main, sub, position, type, condition, date, brand, expected life); saving adds the row with its first history entry; the crane-view Spare parts tab offers the same action pre-filled with the selection (a non-designated part is pre-selected); Management sees neither

Access matrix wording follows U1-C21: the EQ work row names adding spare parts (EQ Team and Admin fixed, FAC Team and Management not allowed); the Admin row keeps spare-part types and expected-life settings; no console errors on the changed screens
